text:
Two resistors are connected in series with a power supply.
Which statement about the circuit is correct?
A
The current from the supply is greater than the current in each resistor.
B
The current from the supply is equal to the current in each resistor.
C
The current from the supply is less than the current in each resistor.
D
The current from the supply is the sum of the currents in each resistor.

options.label: A
options.text: The current from the supply is greater than the current in each resistor.

options.label: B
options.text: The current from the supply is equal to the current in each resistor.

options.label: C
options.text: The current from the supply is less than the current in each resistor.

options.label: D
options.text: The current from the supply is the sum of the currents in each resistor.
